description: Carbon atom, TRIPLET reference (nopen 2 -> 4 alpha / 2 beta orbitals), static and dynamic hyperpolarizability requested at one rung (protocol 1e-4, k 6, response dconv 1e-4). This case pins a GAP: the shell-generic solver converges all three finite-difference legs (static, 0.05, and the second-harmonic leg at 0.10), but the quadratic source is closed-shell only, so both beta nodes stall, are quarantined by the no-progress guard, and NO property row is assembled -- response_properties is empty and the run still exits 0. Alpha assembly is refused for the same reason (calc_executor.hpp:2323). The assertions below therefore pin the unrestricted reference, the converged legs, and the recorded drop. When open-shell quadratic response lands, replace the stop_reason and dropped_work checks with beta_zzz values and regenerate with a justification. Reference: RelWithDebInfo, TBB, 1 rank x 7 threads, Seawulf Milan shared, 2026-09-22, commit 087307c22, job 2195092, wall 305 s.
